notes: Frame: x runs left to right, y runs front (y=0, face side) to back (y=3). The body's base plate b1 is the belt, so the figure is built upright.

Step 3: the 4 dark blue 1x1 plates are stacked two high at each end of the brown 1x4 plate. The clip plate b9 and the plain 1x2 plate b10 are stacked in the middle. The finished unit sits on the back dark blue brick b2.
Step 4: the two yellow round bricks fill the 2x2 hole in the middle of the 4x4 base.

Step 8: the first ring of six grey bracket bricks has two bricks on each side (left and right) and one in the middle of the front and back. Step 10: the second ring is the opposite, with two bricks on the front and back and one in the middle of each side. This matches the head views and the side-stud faces the later plates and tiles attach to. The ring sits on the brown plates.
Pieces that attach to horizontal (side) studs of the grey bracket bricks are recorded in other_joins with rests_on empty. This covers the head front, ears, back, and the arm sub-assemblies.
In steps 6 and 7 the tile and clip plate rest on the 2x2 plate (built flat), and that plate is then attached sideways to the grey bracket brick on that side.

Step 12-13 face: the two 2x3 plates cover three stud rows. The tan 1x4 plate takes the bottom row and the tan tile covers it. The dark blue 1x4 plate with two studs takes the next row, and the A tile covers the top two rows. The eyes sit on the two studs of that plate.

Steps 15-18: each ear fills a 4x2 block of side studs on the lower bracket bricks. Each side has a dark tan 1x2 tile and a dark blue 1x2 tile, a dark tan and a dark blue 1x1 tile, and a vertical tan 1x2 plate. The tan slope sits on that plate, and a 2x4 dark blue tile covers the upper bracket brick. The left side is a mirror of the right.

Step 21: the 2x2 plate is attached with its studs up into the underside of the base plate b1 (model turned over). In the upright figure it hangs below b1. Step 22: each leg is a dark blue 1x2 brick on a black 1x2 plate (foot), and the leg brick fits into the underside of the 2x2 plate.
The shield clips onto the left (viewer's left) hand clip b27, as in the final picture. Clip-to-shield is recorded as a clip join, but the exact grip detail is assumed.

Step 23: the base is a black 4x6 plate with the nameplate tile on it. The black 2-stud plate and the black 1x4 tile are placed on the base. The feet b72 and b74 are placed on the base studs. The exact base layout is partly assumed from the small illustration.
Piece counts match the parts list: 79 pieces.
